executiveAssessment.text:
Executive Conclusion. Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown’s primary constraint is inconsistent entry into AI answer sets across relevant traveler needs — not competitor causation.

What the Data Is Telling Us. Scenario Presence is 38.1% (24 of 63 scenarios present; 39 absent). AI Consideration is 33.2% (73/220). When the hotel is absent, Bisha Hotel is the most frequent co-appearing competitor (24 scenarios). That is a secondary observed pattern, not proof that Bisha causes the gap.

Why It Matters. Leadership should prioritize closing representation gaps for traveler needs where the hotel is missing, using verified source findings from the completed AI Visibility Audit — not treat competitor co-appearance as a root cause.

Where the Pattern Is Concentrated. Reality Coverage is 19.0% (4 of 21 attributes recognized; Reality Gap 66.7%). Softest Scenario Capture includes Celebration at 20.0%. Use Bisha’s 24-scenario co-appearance pattern for investigation context only.

What Management Should Focus On Now. Act on Audit-verified issues first: dining-status alignment on Choice/OTAs, and hotel confirmation of canonical meetings inventory. Keep pet/EV and family/location facts consistent without unsupported causal claims.

What Not to Overreact To. No comparable prior official period is available — read these as current levels, not period-over-period change. Competitor co-appearance is an observed pattern, not proof of cause.

What to Review Next. Track Scenario Presence and Reality Coverage on the next ADP check after approved fact updates. Do not assign the hotel to re-audit platforms Dealality already assessed.

actionAgenda.actionTitle: Align dining status after Operations confirms current restaurant/lounge state
actionAgenda.observedIssue: Choice brand page still shows an undated restaurant/lounge closure notice; Booking.com still markets on-site dining (Audit AVA-RBTD-001). Verification status: VERIFIED PROBLEM.
actionAgenda.recommendedAction: Confirm outlet status with Operations; update Choice; align Booking.com dining copy.
actionAgenda.rationale: Addresses a verified public-source conflict. Does not claim guaranteed Scenario Presence uplift.
actionAgenda.expectedSignal: Next ADP will monitor whether dining-related recognition and related scenarios change. Monitoring alone does not establish causation.

impactTracking.note: Later periods may record before/after measurement. Monitoring alone does not establish causation.

implementationSteps: Confirm current restaurant/lounge operating status with hotel Operations.
Update the Choice brand property page with the approved status (or remove the undated closure notice if reopened).
Align Booking.com dining copy to the same approved status.
Archive URLs/screenshots and notify Dealality of completion.
definitionOfDone: Choice brand page reflects approved status.
actionAgenda.nextMonitoringCheck: Next published ADP run — review dining-related Reality Gap recognition and scenario excerpts.
actionAgenda.managementPriorityWhy: Verified source conflict on a guest-facing amenity; suggested timing 2–4 weeks (target date to be confirmed with hotel).

actionAgenda.observedIssue: Public inventories conflict: Choice (17 spaces / >10,000 sq ft / up to 400 guests) vs DTHA (14 venues / 11,000 sq ft / up to 380 guests) vs Cvent (~11,000 sq ft) and DTHA event capacity messaging up to 200 guests (Audit AVA-RBTD-005). Status: NEEDS HOTEL CONFIRMATION.
actionAgenda.recommendedAction: Hotel confirms venue count, total space, largest capacity, and meetings contact; then align Choice and Cvent.
actionAgenda.rationale: Canonical meetings facts must be hotel-approved before directory updates. Does not claim ranking impact.
actionAgenda.expectedSignal: Next ADP will monitor meetings-related scenario presence. Monitoring alone does not establish causation.

impactTracking.note: Monitoring alone does not establish causation.

implementationSteps: Confirm venue count, total meeting space, largest room capacity, and meetings contact.
Publish a hotel-approved meetings fact sheet.
Align Choice and Cvent to the approved facts.
Archive verification evidence.
actionAgenda.nextMonitoringCheck: Next published ADP run — review meetings/business scenario presence excerpts.
actionAgenda.managementPriorityWhy: Fact conflict blocks trustworthy meetings representation; suggested timing 2–4 weeks.

actionAgenda.actionTitle: Keep family, harbourfront, and city-access wording consistent on the official page
actionAgenda.observedIssue: Official Choice copy supports family/harbourfront/convention access while related Reality Gap recognition remains soft (Audit AVA-RBTD-002). Status: VALIDATE SOURCE REPRESENTATION / NEEDS INVESTIGATION.
actionAgenda.recommendedAction: Approve precise wording; update Choice first; cascade selectively. Do not re-audit platforms already assessed in the AVA Audit.
actionAgenda.rationale: Strengthens official representation of already-verified hotel facts. Soft AI recognition alone is not treated as a verified platform defect.
actionAgenda.expectedSignal: Next ADP will monitor Family-Friendly and related location attributes. Monitoring alone does not establish causation.

impactTracking.note: Monitoring alone does not establish causation.

implementationSteps: Approve precise family, harbourfront, and city-access wording.
Update the Choice brand property page first.
Cascade only to channels where Audit found material gaps.
Archive verification evidence.
actionAgenda.nextMonitoringCheck: Next published ADP run — Family-Friendly / harbourfront / access recognition.
actionAgenda.managementPriorityWhy: Supports representation after Priority 1 source conflicts; suggested timing 2–4 weeks.

actionAgenda.actionTitle: Spot-check pet and EV amenity consistency after fact confirmation
actionAgenda.observedIssue: Choice lists pet and EV amenities; Core recognition was 0%. TripAdvisor citation frequency alone does not justify a management-response program (Audit AVA-RBTD-003 / PLATFORM_TRIPADVISOR). Status: MONITOR.
actionAgenda.recommendedAction: Confirm pet/EV policy; spot-check priority OTAs already assessed; monitor recognition next ADP.
actionAgenda.rationale: Hygiene check after fact confirmation. Low recognition alone is not ranked as a verified HIGH source defect.
actionAgenda.expectedSignal: Next ADP will monitor pet/EV attribute recognition. Monitoring alone does not establish causation.

impactTracking.note: Monitoring alone does not establish causation.

implementationSteps: Confirm current pet and EV policies with Operations.
Spot-check priority OTAs for consistency with approved facts.
Log results; no broad multi-platform research assignment to the hotel.
Review recognition on the next ADP run.
actionAgenda.nextMonitoringCheck: Next published ADP run — pet/EV attribute recognition.
actionAgenda.managementPriorityWhy: Supporting hygiene after verified Priority 1 work; suggested timing 2–4 weeks.
